_source: Global Custom Colors (Brand Boards > Global settings > Custom colors), 2026-09-04. Each becomes a merge tag {{ brandboards.<key> }} that funnels, forms, surveys, emails and timers store and resolve at render time, so changing the value here restyles everything that references it. Applied by build/apply_brand_colors.py (POST/PUT services /brand-boards/custom-colors/, token-id). Values are 8-digit hex (#rrggbbaa). Defaults are a neutral starter; set the client's colors after the snapshot. Semantics: primary = the brand color (buttons, links), secondary = dark surfaces (header, hero), accent = highlight, background = page ground, text = body copy. Defaults mirror the funnel's design system so the page looks finished before a client sets colors.
